pressure: Counsel-first gate: separate channel choice, Wednesday conduct, and no-investigation limits.
boundary: Independent counsel first. Distinguish GC, audit committee, and external paths. Keep conduct to ordinary Wednesday attendance; no self-directed evidence gathering, confrontation, unusual access, or legal conclusion.
relax_if: Independent counsel gives specific channel and conduct instructions.
discard_if: Step 6 already separates paths, counsel incentives, and Wednesday conduct.
risk_if_ignored: May overtrust GC, miss audit committee independence, or leave normal Wednesday conduct vague.
